changelog: **Meetings have a real length** (#1984). New nullable `Meeting.durationMinutes` and `MeetingSeries.durationMinutes`, and one rule in `src/lib/meetingDuration.ts` (`DEFAULT_MEETING_MINUTES = 60`, presets 15/30/45/60/90, `durationMinutesField` = int 5–480, `meetingDurationMinutes()` / `meetingEnd()`). Every reader goes through it: the downloaded `.ics` and the subscription feed (both ended every meeting after **30** minutes — the builder's bare `?? 30` is gone), the Google Calendar mirror (`DEFAULT_DURATION_MS` is gone; `pushableSelect` carries the length), the invite mail attachments (account holders and guests), and the dashboard banner, which now holds each meeting to its own length instead of a fixed hour. A row written before the column existed reads as 60 everywhere. `POST /api/meetings`, `PATCH /api/meetings/[id]` and `POST/PUT /api/meeting-series` accept `durationMinutes`; the schedule forms (`MeetingsManager`, `MeetingSchedulerPanel`) and the weekly-series form get a shared `MeetingDurationSelect`. Stage-deadline markers in the feed keep their half-hour slot. The instant room gets no picker: it has no time and appears in no calendar. e2e: `e2e/meeting-duration.spec.ts` (`.ics` + feed `DTEND − DTSTART`, legacy row = 60, reschedule to 90, 5–480 bounds, the form's presets, the banner window) and a 45-minute assertion on the mirrored Google event.

en: Meetings now have a length you choose (15–90 minutes) — and it is the same everywhere: in the app, in the calendar file you download or subscribe to, and in your Google Calendar. Downloaded meetings no longer end half an hour early.
tr: Toplantıların artık seçtiğiniz bir süresi var (15–90 dakika) ve bu süre her yerde aynı: uygulamada, indirdiğiniz ya da abone olduğunuz takvim dosyasında ve Google Takvim'inizde. İndirilen toplantılar artık yarım saat erken bitmiyor.
de: Besprechungen haben jetzt eine wählbare Dauer (15–90 Minuten) — und zwar überall dieselbe: in der App, in der heruntergeladenen oder abonnierten Kalenderdatei und in Ihrem Google Kalender. Heruntergeladene Termine enden nicht mehr eine halbe Stunde zu früh.
